newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KAUBAMAJA OPENS HELSINKI BRANCH APRIL 16.
newsitem.headline: KAUBAMAJA OPENS HELSINKI BRANCH APRIL 16.

text.p: Estonia's Tallinna Kaubamaja is to open its branch in Helsinki on April 16, the company said on Friday.
Tallinna Kaubamaja has invested some 30 million kroons into the store, which is mainly a clothing outlet, the company added in a statement.
Kaubamaja expects the new store to have turnover of 20 million markka in its first year.
The two-storey store in Helsinki has a sales area of 1,150 square metres, the company added.
Tallinna Kaubamaja, which is traded on the free market of the Tallinn stock exchange, is also a major shareholder in the largest store in the southern town of Tartu.
